Ada (Sales): Hey team — quick sync request from Riley at AtlasHealth. They want a 4-week POC for an internal clinical-note summarization feature. Main asks: HIPAA readiness, pen-test, SOC2 artifacts, and a rough cost calc. Riley, can you confirm PHI scope?
Riley (AtlasHealth): Yep — notes will include PHI (patient names, IDs, meds). Need to know if Redwood will sign a BAA and what data residency options exist. Also want success criteria: quality + latency targets.
Sam (SE): Thanks. Operationally: we can run a hosted POC behind a BAA or offer a Private (VPC) deployment depending on residency. For a 4-week run, typical setup: ingest ~10k notes, run 3 eval prompts (full-summarize, problem-list, med-parse), ~50k tokens/day estimate. Can we get sample notes (redacted) and a labeled eval set?
Riley (AtlasHealth): Can provide redacted samples today, and 200 labeled summaries next week. Residency: prefer EU region for some subsets, but primary infra can be in us-west for dev.
Viv (Security): Key items from our side: BAA required for PHI. We need to surface SOC2 Type II report and data flow diagram. Also confirm encryption at rest, TLS in transit, KMS integration for keys, and audit logs retention. Any custom pen-test requests?
Leo (Legal): On the BAA — we can sign once we confirm deployment mode and data access patterns. Also need to confirm subprocessors. Riley, do you have a vendor DPA template or any mandatory clauses?
Riley (AtlasHealth): We have a standard DPA — I'll DM it. Also legal asked for incident response SLAs and notification windows.
Ada (Sales): Pricing question: for a 4-week proof, do we offer free credits or a discounted trial for Private? Sam, what's the estimate?
Sam (SE): If we run hosted with reserved burst capacity: estimate ~ $1,200–1,800 for compute + 2 SE days for onboarding (~$3k equivalent) if we bill standard. For Private/VPC the onboarding and infra baseline is higher — recommend offering a $5k POC package and then adjust to a contract if they convert. We can also waive infra fees if they sign the BAA and commit to a full pilot.
Viv (Security): For the security review timeline: we can produce SOC2 artifacts and the DFD within 3 business days. Pen-test: we require scope agreement; if AtlasHealth wants an on-demand third-party pen-test, that usually takes 3–6 weeks to schedule. We can support an in-scope vulnerability scan within the 4-week POC window.
Leo (Legal): Recommend: 1) get DPA/BAA + vendor clauses reviewed (Riley to share), 2) Redwood to provide SOC2 summary + security whitepaper, 3) agree on incident notif windows (we propose 24h for critical).
Riley (AtlasHealth): 24h notif is fine. For pen-test, AtlasHealth security prefers a light external scan during the POC and a full pen-test post-production.
Sam (SE): On success criteria — propose this for the POC: 1) Quality: >= 85% acceptance rate on 200 labeled summaries (rater-based), 2) Latency: median infer < 400ms on 512-token prompt, 3) Reliability: <1% error rate during test traffic, 4) Ops: integration script and sample pipeline verified. Does that align?
Ada (Sales): Good list. Riley — will your stakeholders accept the 85% threshold?
Riley (AtlasHealth): Yes, product team OK with 85% as long as edge-case log is captured. Also need prompt audits and ability to export logs without PHI.
Viv (Security): For logs: we can provide redaction options and prefix-KV caching disabled for PHI flows. We'll document retention policy and the steps to produce redacted audit exports.
sec-bot: Task created: security/atlas-poc-checklist #432 — includes SOC2 pack, DPA draft, redaction runbook, scan task.
Leo (Legal): Next actionable: Riley share DPA + required clauses today; Ada to confirm which deployment (hosted with BAA vs Private). Sam to prepare a scoped eval harness and token estimate. Viv to prep SOC2 summary and runbook.
Ada (Sales): I'll follow up with a one-pager and a proposed POC SOW by EOD. Thanks everyone.
Riley (AtlasHealth): Thanks all — this is helpful. I'll DM the DPA and provide redacted samples by end of day.
Sam (SE): I'll start a draft eval notebook and post link here when ready.
Viv (Security): I'll upload SOC2 summary to the shared folder + initial redaction playbook.
Ada (Sales): moving to next steps: schedule kickoff for Monday; I'll post the Zoom link. :calendar:
